pictures.scene: Gerard van Honthorst, King David Playing the Harp — David leaning over the strings by candlelight as he sings, a Psalm of David calling the heavenly beings to ascribe glory to the LORD
pictures.name: pd_honthorst_king_david

pictures.scene: Domenico Fetti, Moses before the Burning Bush — Moses loosening his sandal before the bush that burns and is not consumed, ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name
pictures.name: pd_fetti_burning_bush

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Transfiguration — Christ standing in white light with His arms spread wide above the mountain, worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness
pictures.name: pd_angelico_transfiguration

pictures.scene: Ivan Aivazovsky, The Ninth Wave — the great wave towering over the men clinging to the wreckage at sunrise, the God of glory thunders over many waters
pictures.name: pd_aivazovsky_ninth_wave

pictures.scene: Ludolf Backhuysen, Ships in Distress off a Rocky Coast — the ships heeled over under a torn sky beside the rocks, the voice of the LORD is powerful and majestic
pictures.name: pd_backhuysen_ships_in_distress

pictures.scene: Albert Bierstadt, Giant Redwood Trees of California — the enormous trunks rising into the forest dark, the voice of the LORD breaks the cedars of Lebanon
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_redwoods

pictures.scene: Paulus Potter, The Young Bull — the young bull standing in the field with his head lifted, He makes Lebanon skip like a calf and Sirion like a young wild ox
pictures.name: pd_potter_young_bull

pictures.scene: Joseph Mallord William Turner, The Burning of the Houses of Lords and Commons — the fire going up the night sky and burning on the river, the voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire
pictures.name: pd_turner_burning_parliament

pictures.scene: Washington Allston, Elijah in the Desert — the prophet alone on the bare ground among dead trees, the voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness
pictures.name: pd_allston_elijah_desert

pictures.scene: Jacob van Ruisdael, The Jewish Cemetery — the broken trees over the tombs under a breaking storm, the voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare
pictures.name: pd_ruisdael_jewish_cemetery

pictures.scene: Hendrick van Vliet, Interior of the Oude Kerk in Delft — the people small under the great white pillars of the church, and in His temple all cry, Glory
pictures.name: pd_vanvliet_oude_kerk_delft

pictures.scene: Gentile da Fabriano, Coronation of the Virgin — the crowning in heaven with the dove above, the LORD is enthroned as King forever and gives His people strength
pictures.name: pd_gentile_coronation

pictures.scene: Jean-Francois Millet, The Angelus — the two field workers standing still with bowed heads at the hour of prayer, the LORD blesses His people with peace
pictures.name: pd_millet_angelus

lines.text: A Psalm of David.
Ascribe to the LORD, O heavenly beings,
ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name;
worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.
The voice of the LORD is over the waters;
the God of glory thunders;
the LORD is heard over many waters.
The voice of the LORD is powerful;
the voice of the LORD is majestic.
The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars;
the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
He makes Lebanon skip like a calf,
and Sirion like a young wild ox.
The voice of the LORD
strikes with flames of fire.
The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness;
the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.
The voice of the LORD twists the oaks
and strips the forests bare.
And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”
The LORD sits enthroned over the flood;
the LORD is enthroned as King forever.
The LORD gives His people strength;
the LORD blesses His people with peace.
